verses.restored: You shall not sacrifice to YHWH your Divine ox or sheep in which is blemish, any bad thing, for abomination to YHWH your Divine it is.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the LORD thy God any bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish, or any evilfavouredness: for that is an abomination unto the LORD thy God.

modern.text: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep with any defect or serious flaw, for that is detestable to the LORD your God. Purge the Idolater

original.text: לֹא תִזְבַּח֩ לַיהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ שׁ֣וֹר וָשֶׂ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בוֹ֙ מ֔וּם כֹּ֖ל דָּבָ֣ר רָ֑ע כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ הֽוּא

verses.restored: If found in your midst, in one of your gates YHWH your Divine gives you, man or woman who does evil in eyes of YHWH your Divine by crossing his covenant,

familiar.text: If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the LORD thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the LORD thy God, in transgressing his covenant,

modern.text: If a man or woman among you in one of the towns that the LORD your God gives you is found doing evil in the sight of the LORD your God by transgressing His covenant

original.text: כִּֽי יִמָּצֵ֤א בְקִרְבְּךָ֙ בְּאַחַ֣ד שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑ךְ אִ֣ישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה אֶת הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לַעֲבֹ֥ר בְּרִיתֽוֹ

verses.restored: and goes and serves other gods and bows to them, or to sun or moon or any host of heavens that I did not command,

familiar.text: And hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;

modern.text: and going to worship other gods, bowing down to them or to the sun or moon or any of the host of heaven—which I have forbidden—

original.text: וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ וַֽיַּעֲבֹד֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לָהֶ֑ם וְלַשֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ א֣וֹ לַיָּרֵ֗חַ א֛וֹ לְכָל צְבָ֥א הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא צִוִּֽיתִי

verses.restored: and it is told to you and you hear, then you shall inquire diligently; and look, if truth is established, the thing certain, this abomination was done in Israel,

familiar.text: And it be told thee, and thou hast heard of it, and enquired diligently, and, behold, it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel:

modern.text: and if it is reported and you hear about it, you must investigate it thoroughly. If the report is true and such an abomination has happened in Israel,

original.text: וְהֻֽגַּד לְךָ֖ וְשָׁמָ֑עְתָּ וְדָרַשְׁתָּ֣ הֵיטֵ֔ב וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֱמֶת֙ נָכ֣וֹן הַדָּבָ֔ר נֶעֶשְׂתָ֛ה הַתּוֹעֵבָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: you shall bring out that man or that woman who did this evil thing to your gates, the man or woman, and stone them with stones so they die.

familiar.text: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, unto thy gates, even that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.

modern.text: you must bring out to your gates the man or woman who has done this evil thing, and you must stone that person to death.

original.text: וְהֽוֹצֵאתָ֣ אֶת הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֡וּא אוֹ֩ אֶת הָאִשָּׁ֨ה הַהִ֜וא אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָ֠שׂוּ אֶת הַדָּבָ֨ר הָרָ֤ע הַזֶּה֙ אֶל שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ אֶת הָאִ֕ישׁ א֖וֹ אֶת הָאִשָּׁ֑ה וּסְקַלְתָּ֥ם בָּאֲבָנִ֖ים וָמֵֽתוּ

verses.restored: By mouth of two witnesses or three witnesses shall the one dying be put to death; by mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

familiar.text: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

modern.text: On the testimony of two or three witnesses a man shall be put to death, but he shall not be executed on the testimony of a lone witness.

original.text: עַל פִּ֣י שְׁנַ֣יִם עֵדִ֗ים א֛וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עֵדִ֖ים יוּמַ֣ת הַמֵּ֑ת לֹ֣א יוּמַ֔ת עַל פִּ֖י עֵ֥ד אֶחָֽד

verses.restored: Hand of witnesses shall be first against him to put him to death, and afterward hand of all people; so you shall remove evil from your midst.

familiar.text: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.

modern.text: The hands of the witnesses shall be the first in putting him to death, and after that, the hands of all the people. So you must purge the evil from among you. Courts of Law

original.text: יַ֣ד הָעֵדִ֞ים תִּֽהְיֶה בּ֤וֹ בָרִאשֹׁנָה֙ לַהֲמִית֔וֹ וְיַ֥ד כָּל הָעָ֖ם בָּאַחֲרֹנָ֑ה וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: If a matter is too difficult for you in judgment, between blood and blood, claim and claim, lesion and lesion, matters of dispute within your gates, then you shall rise and go up to place YHWH your Divine chooses.

familiar.text: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within thy gates: then shalt thou arise, and get thee up into the place which the LORD thy God shall choose;

modern.text: If a case is too difficult for you to judge, whether the controversy within your gates is regarding bloodshed, lawsuits, or assaults, you must go up to the place the LORD your God will choose.

original.text: כִּ֣י יִפָּלֵא֩ מִמְּךָ֨ דָבָ֜ר לַמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט בֵּֽין דָּ֨ם לְדָ֜ם בֵּֽין דִּ֣ין לְדִ֗ין וּבֵ֥ין נֶ֨גַע֙ לָנֶ֔גַע דִּבְרֵ֥י רִיבֹ֖ת בִּשְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ וְקַמְתָּ֣ וְעָלִ֔יתָ אֶל הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: You shall come to Levitical priests and to judge who is in those days, inquire, and they shall declare to you word of judgment.

familiar.text: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and enquire; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment:

modern.text: You are to go to the Levitical priests and to the judge who presides at that time. Inquire of them, and they will give you a verdict in the case.

original.text: וּבָאתָ֗ אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְאֶל הַשֹּׁפֵ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֑ם וְדָרַשְׁתָּ֙ וְהִגִּ֣ידוּ לְךָ֔ אֵ֖ת דְּבַ֥ר הַמִּשְׁפָּֽט

verses.restored: You shall do according to word they declare to you from that place YHWH chooses, and keep to do according to all they instruct you.

familiar.text: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:

modern.text: You must abide by the verdict they give you at the place the LORD will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you,

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֗יתָ עַל פִּ֤י הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַגִּ֣ידֽוּ לְךָ֔ מִן הַמָּק֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹרֽוּךָ

verses.restored: According to Torah/instruction they teach you and according to judgment they say to you, you shall do; you shall not turn from word they declare to you, right or left.

familiar.text: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee, to the right hand, nor to the left.

modern.text: according to the terms of law they give and the verdict they proclaim. Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from the decision they declare to you.

original.text: עַל פִּ֨י הַתּוֹרָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יוֹר֗וּךָ וְעַל הַמִּשְׁפָּ֛ט אֲשֶׁר יֹאמְר֥וּ לְךָ֖ תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה לֹ֣א תָס֗וּר מִן הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר יַגִּ֥ידֽוּ לְךָ֖ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאל

verses.restored: The man who acts presumptuously, not listening to priest standing to serve there before YHWH your Divine or to judge, that man shall die; so you shall remove evil from Israel.

familiar.text: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the LORD thy God, or unto the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel.

modern.text: But the man who acts presumptuously, refusing to listen either to the priest who stands there to serve the LORD your God, or to the judge, must be put to death. You must purge the evil from Israel.

original.text: וְהָאִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה בְזָד֗וֹן לְבִלְתִּ֨י שְׁמֹ֤עַ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן֙ הָעֹמֵ֞ד לְשָׁ֤רֶת שָׁם֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ א֖וֹ אֶל הַשֹּׁפֵ֑ט וּמֵת֙ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: All people shall hear and fear/revere and not act presumptuously again.

familiar.text: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

modern.text: Then all the people will hear and be afraid, and will no longer behave arrogantly. Guidelines for a King (1 Samuel 8:1–9)

modern.text: you are to appoint over yourselves the king whom the LORD your God shall choose. Appoint a king from among your brothers; you are not to set over yourselves a foreigner who is not one of your brothers.

original.text: שׂ֣וֹם תָּשִׂ֤ים עָלֶ֨יךָ֙ מֶ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בּ֑וֹ מִקֶּ֣רֶב אַחֶ֗יךָ תָּשִׂ֤ים עָלֶ֨יךָ֙ מֶ֔לֶךְ לֹ֣א תוּכַ֗ל לָתֵ֤ת עָלֶ֨יךָ֙ אִ֣ישׁ נָכְרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא אָחִ֖יךָ הֽוּא

verses.restored: Only he shall not multiply horses for himself or return people to Egypt to multiply horses, for YHWH said to you, You shall never return again by this way.

familiar.text: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: forasmuch as the LORD hath said unto you, Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.

modern.text: But the king must not acquire many horses for himself or send the people back to Egypt to acquire more horses, for the LORD has said, ‘You are never to go back that way again.’

original.text: רַק֮ לֹא יַרְבֶּה לּ֣וֹ סוּסִים֒ וְלֹֽא יָשִׁ֤יב אֶת הָעָם֙ מִצְרַ֔יְמָה לְמַ֖עַן הַרְבּ֣וֹת ס֑וּס וַֽיהוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר לָכֶ֔ם לֹ֣א תֹסִפ֗וּן לָשׁ֛וּב בַּדֶּ֥רֶךְ הַזֶּ֖ה עֽוֹד

modern.text: He must not take many wives for himself, lest his heart go astray. He must not accumulate for himself large amounts of silver and gold.

familiar.text: And it shall be, when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites:

modern.text: When he is seated on his royal throne, he must write for himself a copy of this instruction on a scroll in the presence of the Levitical priests.

original.text: וְהָיָ֣ה כְשִׁבְתּ֔וֹ עַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֣א מַמְלַכְתּ֑וֹ וְכָ֨תַב ל֜וֹ אֶת מִשְׁנֵ֨ה הַתּוֹרָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ עַל סֵ֔פֶר מִלִּפְנֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַלְוִיִּֽם

modern.text: It is to remain with him, and he is to read from it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the LORD his God by carefully observing all the words of this instruction and these statutes.

original.text: וְהָיְתָ֣ה עִמּ֔וֹ וְקָ֥רָא ב֖וֹ כָּל יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑יו לְמַ֣עַן יִלְמַ֗ד לְיִרְאָה֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו לִ֠שְׁמֹר אֶֽת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֞י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את וְאֶת הַחֻקִּ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לַעֲשֹׂתָֽם

verses.restored: so his heart is not lifted above his brothers and he does not turn from command right or left, so he may lengthen days over his kingdom, he and his sons, in midst of Israel.

familiar.text: That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left: to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he, and his children, in the midst of Israel.

modern.text: Then his heart will not be exalted above his countrymen, and he will not turn aside from the commandment, to the right or to the left, in order that he and his sons may reign many years over his kingdom in Israel.

original.text: לְבִלְתִּ֤י רוּם לְבָבוֹ֙ מֵֽאֶחָ֔יו וּלְבִלְתִּ֛י ס֥וּר מִן הַמִּצְוָ֖ה יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול לְמַעַן֩ יַאֲרִ֨יךְ יָמִ֧ים עַל מַמְלַכְתּ֛וֹ ה֥וּא וּבָנָ֖יו בְּקֶ֥רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

translation_notes: The blemish rule concerns sacrificial suitability and must not be transferred to disabled people as a measure of worth or holiness.
Idolatry accusations require diligent inquiry and at least two witnesses, but the execution mandate remains a religious-persecution text that must not be reenacted.
The difficult-case court centralizes legal interpretation, but verse 12's death penalty for contempt is morally dangerous and cannot authorize authoritarian religious courts.
The king law is strikingly restrictive: no military horse accumulation, no return to Egypt, no multiplying wives, and no excessive wealth.
Royal Torah study exists to prevent the king's heart from rising above his brothers.
The foreigner exclusion reflects ancient kinship politics and must not justify xenophobic citizenship or leadership bans today.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 17 to execute people for belief, stigmatize disability, create unaccountable religious courts, enforce xenophobic leadership rules, or defend monarchy as sacred domination. Center evidence, appeal, limits on military power, limits on wealth and sexual accumulation, and the principle that rulers remain siblings under Torah.
